outcomes.summary: Validated the Angular Excel add-in POC scope: supported insertion scenarios were ready, and native task-pane-to-grid drag was rejected because Office.js provides no supported drop-target contract.

Implemented the local Angular Excel POC at git:3ec943a9a1fd658c05a9f41954244e208e676aa4, including shared variable values, selected-range insertion, context-menu insertion, custom-function behavior, local HTTPS manifest configuration, documentation, and focused tests.
Completed a clean review with zero active findings; all 11 requirements and 10 coverage dimensions were traced.
Independently confirmed the clean review artifact and its resolved lifecycle transitions at the reviewed revision.

decisions: Native drag from the Office task pane to an Excel grid cell is explicitly unsupported and is not simulated; select-then-click and cell-context-menu insertion are the documented alternatives.

The POC remains local on features/excel-variable-insertion-poc at git:3ec943a9a1fd658c05a9f41954244e208e676aa4; no push, pull request, or pipeline run was performed under the local-poc-delivery route.
No durable shared knowledge was promoted because the verified implementation decisions are POC- and repository-specific, while the applicable member-ordering standard already exists globally.
This is a user-requested manual closure; Pipeline Monitor was intentionally not run because the POC has no remote repository, pull request, or pipeline.
verification: Independent review verification is bound to review-result.json SHA-256 fb4d61d794a26224746700500c09c8f2fa26af3f122509c5d9455327532139ff at git:3ec943a9a1fd658c05a9f41954244e208e676aa4.
Format check, lint, strict TypeScript checks, 16/16 tests, production build, Office manifest validation, and production dependency audit passed.
Reviewer and independent verifier reported no active product or agent-process findings.
residualItems: Pipeline Monitor was not run. This is intentionally incomplete delivery work for the manual closure because the POC has no remote repository, pull request, or pipeline.

Excel desktop smoke checks for sideloaded task-pane insertion, multi-range insertion, cell context-menu insertion, and worksheet custom-function behavior were documented but not executed in this non-interactive run.

The development-only office-addin-manifest dependency chain has two moderate npm audit advisories; npm audit --omit=dev reported zero production vulnerabilities, and the offered forced remediation is breaking.

humanReadable.title: Excel variable insertion POC
humanReadable.overview: The local Angular Excel add-in POC is manually closed after independent review and verification. It demonstrates supported variable-insertion paths without adding a backend, macros, external data access, or a simulated unsupported drag-and-drop experience. No durable shared knowledge changed.
delivered: A task pane with ten stable mock variables that writes the selected value to every area of the current Excel selection.
A cell context-menu command that inserts the same active variable through the shared insertion path.
A public VARIABLEPOC.GETVARIABLE custom function with an explicit host-visible #N/A response for unknown identifiers.
Local HTTPS Office add-in configuration, sideloading and smoke-test documentation, and focused automated coverage.
decisions: Native task-pane-to-grid dragging is not part of the POC because Office.js does not expose the required supported drop-target contract.
The supported alternatives are select-then-click insertion and the Excel cell context-menu command.
The work remains local; the selected delivery route did not authorize a push, pull request, or pipeline execution.
verification: Formatting, linting, strict type checks, 16 focused tests, production build, manifest validation, and production dependency audit passed.
A clean Reviewer result and an independent Review Verifier result confirm zero active findings at git:3ec943a9a1fd658c05a9f41954244e208e676aa4.
residualItems: Pipeline delivery was intentionally not run because this local POC has no remote repository, pull request, or pipeline; manual closure records it as incomplete delivery work.
Run the documented Excel desktop smoke checks before relying on task-pane, context-menu, multi-range, manifest-sideloading, or worksheet-function behavior in a target host.
Track the development-only office-addin-manifest dependency advisories separately; production dependencies have no reported audit vulnerabilities.
